### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer III leading scalable software development for Avalon Healthcare Solutions, a diagnostic intelligence company. Owning complex projects, architecture, mentoring, and production reliability.

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer III leading scalable software development for Avalon Healthcare Solutions, a diagnostic intelligence company. Owning complex projects, architecture, mentoring, and production reliability.
Software Engineer III building scalable healthcare diagnostics software for Avalon Healthcare Solutions
Role description:
• Lead the design and development of scalable, high-quality software solutions aligned with business goals and technical strategy
• Own complex features and projects from planning through implementation, testing, and deployment
• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to define technical requirements and deliver projects
• Contribute to architectural discussions with principal engineers and architects
• Mentor junior and mid-level engineers
• Conduct and lead code reviews
• Troubleshoot complex application and integration issues and contribute to root cause analysis
• Participate in Agile SDLC activities, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives
• Occasionally coordinate technical efforts as a project lead
• Apply health plan operations domain knowledge to technical decisions
• Participate in the on-call rotation and support production stability
Role requirements:
• Advanced proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Go, or TypeScript
• Deep understanding of relational and non-relational databases, including query optimization and data modeling
• Expert-level experience with Git and source control workflows
• Proficiency configuring and optimizing development environments and tooling
• Strong experience designing and integrating RESTful and event-driven web services and APIs
• Comfortable working in Linux-based environments
• Deep understanding of Agile methodologies and the full SDLC
• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI
• Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes
• Strong grasp of secure coding, performance optimization, and system reliability principles
• Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers
• Experience contributing to or influencing architectural decisions
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills
• Strong collaboration, analytical, problem-solving, initiative, autonomy, ownership, and accountability skills
• Preferred: cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; React or Next.js; testing frameworks such as JUnit, Jest, Mocha, or Playwright; regulated-industry experience; HIPAA, PHI, and IIHI knowledge
Benefits:
• Eligible for remote work
• Quarterly travel to Avalon's corporate office
• Mentoring and professional growth opportunities
• Equal Opportunity Employer - Vet/Disability
Tech stack:
AWS, Azure, Cloud, Docker, Google Cloud Platform, Java, JavaScript, Jenkins, Jest, JUnit, Kubernetes, Linux, Mocha, Next.js, React, SDLC, TypeScript, Go
